meta_description: Trafford Decorators provides professional interior and exterior painting and decorating across Manchester. Free quotes, quality finishes, reliable service.
hero_eyebrow: Professional Painters & Decorators — Serving Manchester Since 2004
hero_subhead: From worn walls to stunning rooms — we handle interior painting, exterior work, and specialist finishes. Free quotes, no obligation.
services_heading: Painting & Decorating Services Across Greater Manchester
services_subhead: From routine room redecorating to specialist finishes and exterior work, we handle projects large and small with care and attention to detail.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decorating
services.desc: Transform living spaces with expert interior painting and wallpapering. We prepare surfaces properly, use premium paints, and deliver flawless finishes that last.

services.title: Exterior Painting & Rendering
services.desc: Protect and refresh your home's exterior. Weather-resistant paints, render repairs, and woodwork treatment keep your property looking sharp and standing up to Manchester weather.

services.title: Woodwork & Joinery Painting
services.desc: Doors, skirting, cornicing, and fitted furniture deserve expert attention. We sand, prime, and paint to a professional standard — crisp lines, smooth finishes, no drips.

services.title: Specialist Finishes
services.desc: Feature walls, faux effects, murals, and textured finishes. Whether you want bold colour, subtle texture, or bespoke design, we bring your vision to life.

services.title: Commercial Decorating
services.desc: Offices, shops, and hospitality venues need reliable, timely work. We schedule around your hours and deliver professional results on time and on budget.

services.title: Surface Preparation & Repairs
services.desc: Proper prep is everything. We handle plaster repairs, cracks, damp issues, and surface cleaning — the foundation of a perfect finish.

about_pullquote: I started this business on one simple rule: treat every job like your own home.
about_para_1: Trafford Decorators was founded in 2004 by Mark Trafford, a Manchester tradesman frustrated by sloppy work and poor communication from other decorators. What began as a one-man operation has grown into a trusted team of painters and decorators serving Greater Manchester, Cheshire, and Lancashire. We've completed over 2,500 jobs — from small flat redecorations to major commercial refurbishments — and built a reputation for reliability, quality finishes, and straightforward pricing.
about_para_2: We don't cut corners or rush jobs. Every project starts with a proper site survey, honest quotation, and clear timescales. Our customers return to us again and again because we show up on time, protect their homes during work, and take pride in leaving spaces that look genuinely beautiful. We're fully insured, use high-quality materials, and stand behind our work with a warranty on finishes.
reviews_heading: What Manchester Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Mark came round to quote for our lounge and hallway repaint. Price was fair, and he got the job done in three days without any fuss. Walls look absolutely brilliant — sharp edges, perfect colour match. Would definitely use again.
reviews.author: David P.

reviews.text: Had our kitchen cabinets and all the woodwork painted. They did a really thorough job — sanded everything back properly, no drips or rough patches. Looks like brand new furniture. Very professional team.
reviews.author: Jennifer L.

reviews.text: Exterior of our 1930s semi was looking tired. Trafford Decorators sorted the render, painted all the woodwork, and the whole house looks smart again. Good value and they cleaned up every day. Highly recommend them.
reviews.author: Robert M.
